summary: Coos County, NH station on Dix's Peak near Dixville Notch: an emergency station in 1921, temporarily discontinued in 1922; the tower is gone.

facts.status_note: Tower gone. A 2006 column describes anchors on Dixville Peak, which no source says is this summit; no source describes the site since.

notes_for_editor: Dix Peak (Forest Lookouts, FFLA list) and Dixville Peak (2006 column) are matched as one summit by the Dixville Notch location only; the column names no tower, and the story says plainly that no source states the two names are one summit. The 1921-22 report, as quoted by Forest Lookouts, calls the station new and an emergency station but gives no build date, so no built event. The 1921 entry is 'other' because the source does not say when the station was first staffed. Status 'gone' from FFLA matches the brief; the anchors are the only remains described, and that is a 2006 description. NHDFL pages returned 403 and the NHLR cache has no record for this site. No photos found. Search budget: 2 WebSearch calls; about 4 page reads.
